designDecisionMadeDuringImplementation_n.cacheAcrossCallersCaveat: The async feasibility job (P-155) is cached and shared PER PARCEL, not per caller -- an already-composed job's bytes are reused for any subsequent caller polling the same parcelNodeId. The composer-level gate applies at COMPOSE time; a caller reading an ALREADY-CACHED job gets bytes composed under whichever caller's tier triggered that compose. Analysis: this is NOT an additional gap beyond the already-flagged CP1 Q5 (unauthenticated direct-to-engine bypass), because both real callers (PE BFF, smartsite-mcp) re-run their OWN local Studio/property-unlock check on EVERY invocation regardless of this cache, so a less-entitled caller never reaches the download step through either mediated path -- confirmed by reading tools.ts's export_instrument handler, which checks canRunStudioReport/hasPropertyUnlock before every call, not just the first. Documented in code comments (parcel-terrain.ts) and in leave_behind below rather than re-architecting job-keying, which would be a materially larger, unapproved scope change (no DB schema change was in the approved design).
designDecisionMadeDuringImplementation_n.resultSummaryNotUsed: Considered persisting the entitlement marker into the job's resultSummary (a DB-backed field per packages/storage/src/port.ts's FeasibilityExportJob type) but found it is a STRONGLY TYPED, closed set of columns requiring a new migration to extend -- outside the CP1-approved, no-schema-change design. Instead the GET status route recomputes the marker FRESH from the CURRENT request's own gate-front context on every read, which is actually more correct (reflects the live caller, not a frozen compose-time snapshot) and required zero storage changes.
